You will manage contract execution, lead change and claims management processes, and ensure alignment between customer contracts and downstream execution contracts to reduce commercial and delivery risk. You will act as the contractual focal point for delivery projects, ensuring contractual governance, managing risk and supporting project teams in achieving successful commercial and delivery outcomes. Working closely with Project Managers, Procurement, Commercial and Legal teams, you will help drive contractual discipline and support successful execution throughout the project lifecycle. This role is located in the Espoo-area in Finland and reports directly to the Director of Delivery. Key responsibilities: Manage the full lifecycle of construction contracts, including drafting, review, execution, administration, and close-out Support and participate in contract negotiations with General Contractors and key suppliers Ensure contractual compliance with YSE 1998, international standards, and Finnish construction laws Act as the central point for contract interpretation and provide guidance to project teams Own and structure change management processes, ensuring proper documentation and approval of variations Lead and support claims management (EOT, cost claims), including preparation of positions and supporting documentation Monitor contract performance, proactively identifying risks, gaps, deviations, and opportunities Maintain project-level contract risk registers and ensure transparency of contractual exposure and reporting Ensure alignment between customer contracts and downstream GC/supplier agreements, translating requirements into executable scopes and obligations Drive effective stakeholder collaboration (Project Management, Procurement, Commercial, Legal), while supporting continuous improvement of contract processes, templates, and best practices Your profile: You are an experienced professional with a strong background in contract management within construction or infrastructure projects. You have a clear understanding of both customer-side and contractor-side contracts and can effectively bridge requirements between them. You are structured, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in complex, fast-paced project environments. You bring strong analytical and negotiation skills and can effectively support project teams in managing contractual risks and obligations. You are proactive, commercially minded and capable of balancing contractual protection with practical project execution. You are comfortable influencing stakeholders and navigating complex contractual environments while maintaining a collaborative approach. Background & Experience: Degree in Law, Engineering, Construction Management, or related field (Master’s preferred). 7+ years of experience in contract management, commercial management, or construction law. Experience from data center, industrial, infrastructure or other capital-intensive environments is considered an advantage. Strong understanding of both customer contracts and execution (GC) contracts and their interaction. Strong knowledge of Finnish construction standards and legal frameworks. Experience with GC contracts (e.g. GMP, Cost+, Design & Build) and claims processes. Strong understanding of risk allocation and contract structures. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. For us, an open, transparent, and inclusive culture is more than a priority, it is the core of how we lead and innovate. We don’t just talk about culture; we nurture it. Through regular one-to-one engagements and monthly wellbeing surveys, we listen carefully to our teams, ensuring that every voice is heard and every opportunity for improvement is embraced. We recognize that innovation and collaboration thrive where people feel truly connected, which is why we come together each week to share ideas, strengthen relationships, and nurture a sense of belonging, sometimes over a simple breakfast and good conversation. At atNorth, we are building a community where you can do your best work and shape a sustainable future together. review_candidates.location: Ho Chi Minh City, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
review_candidates.description: Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic, and labelling is accurate. Eurofins is dedicated to delivering testing services that contribute to the health and safety of society and the planet, and to its corporate responsibility to protect the environment and ensure diversity, equity, and inclusion across the entire network of Eurofins companies. Job Description We are looking for a proactive and customer-focused Principal Product Sustenance Engineer to drive product support, incident resolution, and continuous product improvements. The ideal candidate should possess strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, collaborate effectively across multiple teams, and ensure timely resolution of production issues while maintaining high customer satisfaction. Key Responsibilities Lead investigation and resolution of complex production issues and customer-reported incidents. Handle user access management and data management (importation, update, migration etc.) requests. Lead troubleshooting and coordinate with Dev, Infra, and Network teams. Working knowledge of ESB (Enterprise Service Bus) or Message Queuing (MSMQ) is an added advantage Experience with an observability platform like Grafana for troubleshooting, monitoring and alerting is a must. Analyse application logs, SQL data, and system behaviour to identify root causes. Experience in writing SQL queries for troubleshooting, data validation, and issue analysis. Coordinate with Development, QA, Product Management, Infrastructure, and Customer Support teams to drive issue resolution. Track, follow up, and ensure timely closure of action items across cross-functional teams. Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and recommend preventive and corrective actions. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce incident volume and improve product stability. Qualifications 4-6 years of working experience in L2 production/application support. Technical Skills: Proficient in writing SQL queries for data analysis and issue investigation. Ability to verify and validate data across multiple systems and databases. Hands-on experience in converting Excel data into SQL scripts. Experience in troubleshooting application errors using logs, SQL queries, and system diagnostics. Good understanding of enterprise application architecture and business workflows. Experience in integration troubleshooting (REST APIs, file-based, message-based and service integrations). Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools such as Grafana, Kibana, Splunk, or similar tools is desirable. Working knowledge of programming languages and software development lifecycle (SDLC), release management, and incident management processes. Functional Skills: Excellent business communication and stakeholder management skills. Excellent domain knowledge - meaning a very good understanding of the business, applications, and functionalities. Strong ownership with the ability to drive issues to closure. Excellent follow-up and action tracking skills. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Ability to quickly understand business processes and product functionality. Experience coordinating across multiple teams and managing competing priorities. Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering high-quality support. Additional Information We support your development! Do you feel you don’t match 100% of the requirements? Don’t hesitate to apply anyway! Eurofins companies are committed to supporting your career development. We embrace diversity! As an Equal Opportunity Employer, the Eurofins network of companies believes in strength and innovation through diversity. We prohibit discrimination against employees or applications based on gender identity and/or expression, race, nationality, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, and everything else that makes employees of Eurofins companies unique. Sustainability matters to us! We are well on our way to achieving our objective of carbon neutrality by 2025, through a combination of emission reduction and compensation initiatives. We encourage our laboratory leaders to make sustainable changes at their local level, and in addition to their initiatives we count on our dedicated carbon reduction team to help us to achieve this goal! Find out more on our Careers page: https://careers.eurofins.com/ Company description : Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products. In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to ca. 63,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1,000 companies across 60 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products. In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6.95 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.
